text:
Moritz Seider is playing 25.9 minutes a night, blocking shots at a huge rate (53 already) and wearing Detroit's frustration on his sleeve. In a 4-0 loss in Colorado on Nov. 7 he dropped the gloves with Gabriel Landeskog, and the Detroit Free Press headline was "Moritz Seider discusses frustration." The Red Wings have lost four of their last five. The Free Press also reports Detroit won't name a captain this season and calls Seider an "all in" guy, which says a lot about the season around him.

He has no goals yet, 10 assists, and his ten-game run of 5 points sits a little under what our numbers expected. At 5v5 the Wings are about even with him on the ice.

That's below the player Evolving-Hockey saw last season: 4.3 wins above replacement, 3rd among 215 defensemen, 99th percentile at taking chances away. We'd expect that player to show up again. The workload is not the problem. Detroit just needs more from everyone else.
headline: Seider carries Detroit's minutes and its frustration
